rules.sentence: A suprascapular nerve CSA of >4.2 mm2 had a sensitivity of 86% and a specificity of 92% for neuralgic amyotrophy.
The ultrasound appearances of neuralgic amyotrophy are localized neural swelling ± fascicular entwinement ± hourglass constriction.
If one sees neural swelling on transverse ultrasound scanning, longitudinal scanning should be performed to evaluate the presence of hourglass constriction.
